Name: Simple Time Mod
Author: figtrane
Description:
This mod is intended to be a simpler alternative to other time mods. It works by multiplying Stardew Valley's base time progression value by whatever value is entered in the config. By default, days are 2x longer. The Skull Cavern's slower time progression has been retained.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] is highly recommended but not required for the mod to function.
[s]
[i][size=2]This mod has not yet been tested with multiplayer. Use with caution.[/size]
[/i][/s][size=3][left]Multiplayer compatible as of 1.1.0![/left][/size]
